mapper.select: SELECT stat_date AS statDate, SUM(qty_sold) AS totalQty, COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) AS skuCount FROM order_sales_daily WHERE stat_date >= #{dateFrom} AND stat_date <= #{dateTo} GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT DATE_SUB(stat_date, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(stat_date) DAY) AS weekStart, SUM(qty_sold) AS totalQty, COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) AS skuCount FROM order_sales_daily WHERE stat_date >= #{dateFrom} AND stat_date <= #{dateTo} GROUP BY DATE_SUB(stat_date, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(stat_date) DAY) ORDER BY weekStart

SELECT d.sku_id AS skuId, ps.sku_code AS skuCode, p.name AS productName, SUM(d.qty_sold) AS totalQty FROM order_sales_daily d LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON d.sku_id = ps.id LEFT JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.id WHERE d.stat_date >= #{dateFrom} AND d.stat_date <= #{dateTo} GROUP BY d.sku_id, ps.sku_code, p.name ORDER BY totalQty DESC, d.sku_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.stat_date AS statDate, s.sku_id AS skuId, ps.sku_code AS skuCode, p.name AS productName, s.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.wh_name AS whName, s.qty_on_hand AS qtyOnHand, s.qty_locked AS qtyLocked, s.qty_transit AS qtyTransit, s.qty_available AS qtyAvailable FROM inventory_snapshot_daily s LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON s.sku_id = ps.id LEFT JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.stat_date = #{date} ORDER BY ps.sku_code, w.wh_name

SELECT t.sku_id AS skuId, MAX(t.sku_code) AS skuCode, MAX(t.product_name) AS productName FROM ( SELECT d.sku_id, ps.sku_code, p.name AS product_name FROM order_sales_daily d LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON d.sku_id = ps.id LEFT JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.id UNION ALL SELECT s.sku_id, ps.sku_code, p.name AS product_name FROM inventory_snapshot_daily s LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON s.sku_id = ps.id LEFT JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.id ) t GROUP BY t.sku_id ORDER BY skuCode LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT ps.id AS skuId, ps.sku_code AS skuCode, p.name AS productName FROM product_sku ps LEFT JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.id WHERE ps.id = #{skuId}
